integrity: The reversal criterion is proved algebraically from the definitions of ARR, RRR, and NNT. The finite lower boundary is exhaustively enumerated with exact rational arithmetic, and the all-larger-size witness family is proved symbolically and replayed through arm size 500.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to balanced binary trials, beneficial treatment, strictly positive 2x2 cells, and point-estimate comparison. It does not cover unequal arm sizes, zero-cell corrections, sampling uncertainty, treatment harms, or external transport across baseline-risk populations.
title: Absolute and relative risk reduction first reverse at six patients per arm
